# US x Iran effective ceasefire by Aug 31: research as of 2026-08-08

As of Aug 8, no US strike on Iranian territory has been reported since the late-July wave (July 29, possibly through July 31). If none happens, the 14-day window closes about Aug 12-14, well before the Aug 31 deadline.

## 1. Resolution source
- The criteria give no URL. Resolution rests on a "consensus of resolution sources", meaning major media reporting on US strikes that hit Iranian land.
- I couldn't open the Polymarket market page (the proxy refused the connection), so I can't report its current live status.
- 2026-07-15: Aggregators show the market event, "US x Iran Effective Ceasefire by...? (2 week pause)", was created around this date. [lines.com](https://www.lines.com/prediction-markets/world/us-x-iran-effective-ceasfire-byptptpt-2-week-pause-20260715194822042), [predscope](https://predscope.com/event/us-x-iran-effective-ceasfire-byptptpt-2-week-pause-20260715194822042)

## 2. Current status
- The question isn't settled yet, but it is well advanced.
- **Most likely last strike, July 29 (ET):** CENTCOM ended a "heavy wave" of strikes at 10 p.m. ET that night, including hits on Qeshm Island. If no further strike occurs, the 14-day period runs from July 30 to 12:00 PM ET on Aug 12. That matches the question's stated resolution time of about Aug 12. [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/30/us-launches-another-round-of-attacks-on-iran), [Democracy Now](https://www.democracynow.org/2026/7/30/headlines/us_strikes_irgc_targets_inside_iran_killing_3_people_on_qeshm_island)
- **Possible later end date, July 31:** A Wikipedia page lists the July campaign as running through July 31 and ending with Trump's pause. I couldn't confirm any strike on July 30 or 31. If one happened, the window would end around Aug 14, still well before Aug 31. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/July_2026_United_States_strikes_against_Iran)
- **Aug 1 to Aug 8:** I found no reports of US strikes on Iranian land in this period.
- **Remaining risk:** Any qualifying US strike before the window completes would restart the 14-day clock. With a restart as late as about Aug 17, there would still be room for a full window to start before Aug 31.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-07: Houthis attacked a Saudi base in Yemen and the Najran region. Iraqi militias postponed retaliation for US-Saudi strikes in Iraq. Gen. Caine has reportedly said privately that the US needs an "off-ramp" from the Iran war. [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/08/07/world/live-news/iran-war-trump)
- 2026-08-07: A draft Iran-Oman text on the Strait of Hormuz is under review in Iran's parliament and still needs the Supreme Leader's approval. Trump said the war has "got to end pretty soon." [GlobalSecurity](https://www.globalsecurity.org/military/ops/iran-war-update.htm)
- 2026-08-06: Trump said the US has "massive amounts" of munitions, after reports of low stockpiles. Iran denied direct talks with the US and said Iran and Oman are close to a Hormuz framework. [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/08/06/world/live-news/iran-war-trump), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/8/6/iran-war-live-tehran-oman-close-in-on-hormuz-deal-houthis-attack-tankers)
- 2026-08-05: Houthis claimed an attack on a Saudi oil tanker. Trump said Hormuz would reopen "soon." [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/08/05/world/live-news/iran-war-trump)
- 2026-08-04: Iran continued Hormuz talks with Oman, and the US signalled optimism on a deal. [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/08/04/world/live-news/iran-war-trump)
- 2026-08-02/03: Trump called Iran's leadership "unbelievably duplicitous" after Tehran denied that talks had resumed. [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/08/02/world/live-news/iran-war-trump)
- 2026-08-01: Trump called off planned strikes, saying the pause depends on "being able to rapidly make a DEAL." He said Israel had joined the pause. [NBC](https://www.nbcnews.com/world/middle-east/state-department-urges-americans-consider-leaving-middle-east-region-rcna590396), [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/08/01/world/live-news/iran-war-trump)
- 2026-07-29/30: The US resumed strikes after a five-night pause, in retaliation for Iranian missile fire on a US base in Jordan. [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/30/us-launches-another-round-of-attacks-on-iran)

## 4. Base rates
- 2026-07-07 to 07-23: The US struck Iran almost nightly. CENTCOM reported its 13th consecutive night of strikes on July 23. [CENTCOM](https://www.centcom.mil/MEDIA/PUBLIC-RELEASES/Article/4554310/us-concludes-13th-night-of-strikes-on-iranian-military-targets/)
- 2026-07-24 to 07-28: A five-night pause was broken by retaliation for an Iranian attack on US forces.
- 2026-06-17 to 07-07: The Islamabad ceasefire memorandum held for about three weeks before collapsing over shipping. [GlobalSecurity](https://www.globalsecurity.org/military/ops/iran-war-update.htm)
- Trump has announced pauses many times (in March, and again on Aug 1), and strikes often resumed afterwards. [PBS](https://www.pbs.org/newshour/amp/politics/trump-frequently-announces-hes-halting-strikes-in-iran-but-they-keep-happening)
- Overall, lulls of 14 days or more have happened in this war (for example, late June to early July), but escalation triggers have been frequent: Iranian attacks on US bases and on shipping.

## 5. Other forecasts
- 2026-07-16: Polymarket's Aug 31 contract was about 59% Yes. [lines.com](https://www.lines.com/prediction-markets/world/us-x-iran-effective-ceasfire-byptptpt-2-week-pause-20260715194822042)
- 2026-07-24: It was reported at about 51% Yes. [Octagon](https://www.octagonai.co/markets/iran/ceasefire/us-x-iran-effective-ceasefire-by-2-week-pause.md)
- Around 2026-08-04: Octagon's analysis said both the market and its own model expected a Yes. I couldn't open the page to verify this.
- Undated: A CoinGape page reported about 95-96% Yes. I couldn't confirm its date. [CoinGape](https://coingape.com/prediction-markets/will-us-x-iran-have-an-effective-ceasefire-by-august-31/)
- I found nothing on Kalshi or Manifold.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- **Aug 12, 12:00 PM ET:** The 14-day window completes if July 29 really was the last strike (around Aug 14 if a July 31 strike is confirmed).
- **Iran-Oman Hormuz framework:** The draft still needs approval from Iran's parliament and the Supreme Leader. Iran's denial of US talks could prompt Trump to drop the "rapid deal" condition and resume strikes.
- **Retaliation risks:** Iranian or proxy attacks on US bases (Jordan, Iraq) or on shipping could trigger US retaliation. That is how the July 24-28 pause ended. Houthi and Iraqi militia activity is also escalating.
- **Aug 17:** The Islamabad memorandum is reportedly due to expire on this date, per the GlobalSecurity tracker. That source's dates are inconsistent, so treat this as unverified.
